datasets.title: Building Damage Assessment in Bagerhat District, Khulna Division, Bangladesh as of 4 June 2024
datasets.description: UNOSAT code: FL20240502BGD, GDACS ID: 1001064 This map illustrates potentially damaged structures as observed by using a Pléiades satellite image acquired on 4 June 2024 at 10:31 Local Time. Within the analysis extent, UNOSAT identified 1,100 potentially damaged structures. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/building-damage-assessment-in-bagerhat-district-khulna-division-bangladesh-as-of-4-june-20]
datasets.details: This is a preliminary assessment and has not yet been validated in the field. It is important to consider the characteristics of the source imagery used in the analyses when interpreting results. For damage assessments it should be noted that only significant damage to the structural integrity of the buildings analyzed can be seen in imagery, while minor damage such as cracks or holes may not be visible at all. For flood extractions using radar data it is important to note that urban areas and highly vegetated areas may mask the flood signature and result in underestimation of flood waters. Users with specific questions or concerns should contact unosat@unitar.org to seek clarification.

lineage.description: UNOSAT analysts compared Pléiades satellite imagery acquired on 4 June 2024 with reference imagery to identify structural damage in Bagerhat District, Bangladesh following a tropical cyclone event. The analysis identified 1,100 potentially damaged structures through visual interpretation of satellite data; this is a preliminary assessment not yet validated in the field.

sources.name: United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT)
sources.description: Satellite-based damage assessment using Pléiades imagery acquired on 4 June 2024, identifying 1,100 potentially damaged structures in Bagerhat District through multi-temporal image comparison analysis.
